pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā purāṇarājorodhā bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.3: aññatarā bhikkhunī anabhiratiyā pīḷitā yena sā bhikkhunī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.4: rājā kho ayye tumhe cirāciraṃ gacchati,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.8: atha kho sā bhikkhunī tassā bhikkhuniyā jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ācikkhi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.9: atha kho sā bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyitvā dhovituṃ vissaritvā ekamantaṃ chaḍḍesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.10: bhikkhuniyo makkhikāhi samparikiṇṇaṃ passitvā evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.12: sā evam āha: mayh' idaṃ kamman ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.13: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā tā ujjhāyanti --pa--: kathaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.18: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:2.4: samphassaṃ sādiyantī antamaso uppalapattam pi muttakaraṇaṃ paveseti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
